children: UBS still expects the Reserve Bank of Australia to raise the official cash rate another 25 basis points in November, though that forecast is still contingent on the shape of coming 3Q inflation data. George Tharenou, chief economist for Australia and New Zealand at UBS, says the RBA's narrative is clearly hawkish amid warnings from Deputy Gov. Andrew Hauser on Wednesday that the inflation outlook looks "materially worse." A hike in November is 41% priced by markets. (james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
